workflows.name: tmt_differential_abundance_analysis
workflows.intent: Preprocess, normalize, summarize, and perform differential abundance testing on TMT proteomics data.
input: raw.pd (Proteome Discoverer PSM sheet or equivalent raw output from MaxQuant, SpectroMine, OpenMS, or Philosopher)
annotation.pd (User-created CSV file containing experimental design mapping for runs, channels, mixtures, bioreplicates, and conditions)
workflows.stages:
1. Convert raw search engine output and annotation into the standardized MSstatsTMT format using the appropriate converter function (e.g., PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat, MaxQtoMSstatsTMTFormat, SpectroMinetoMSstatsTMTFormat, OpenMStoMSstatsTMTFormat, or PhilosophertoMSstatsTMTFormat).
2. Perform protein-level summarization, missing value imputation, and normalization across channels and runs using proteinSummarization.
3. Generate diagnostic profile plots or quality control plots using dataProcessPlotsTMT.
4. Test for significant changes in protein abundance across conditions using groupComparisonTMT with either pairwise comparisons or a custom contrast matrix.
workflows.code:
input.pd <- PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat(raw.pd, annotation.pd, 
                                 which.proteinid = "Protein.Accessions")

quant.msstats <- proteinSummarization(input.pd,
                                      method="msstats",
                                      global_norm=TRUE,
                                      reference_norm=TRUE,
                                      remove_norm_channel = TRUE,
                                      remove_empty_channel = TRUE)

dataProcessPlotsTMT(data=quant.msstats,
                     type = 'ProfilePlot',
                     width = 21, # adjust the figure width since there are 15 TMT runs.
                     height = 7)

test.pairwise <- groupComparisonTMT(quant.msstats, moderated = TRUE)

comparison<-matrix(c(-1,0,0,1),nrow=1)
row.names(comparison)<-"1-0.125"
colnames(comparison)<- c("0.125", "0.5", "0.667", "1")

test.contrast <- groupComparisonTMT(data = quant.msstats, contrast.matrix = comparison, moderated = TRUE)
